title: Choose the visual world for Medical Mattress Care
question: The roll assigned The Box Label. Keep it, take an alternate, or re-roll.

options.label: The Box Label
options.lineage: the printed label on every medical device box a care home receives: REF, LOT, CE, symbols, barcode
options.thesis: Every product is shown the way purchasers meet it on delivery: as its own box label, order code first.
materials: giant order codes in Fira Sans
options.viewport: The full-screen indigo fabric hero stays; a big label block sits on it: REF MMC V10, 'Op voorraad in Sint-Pauwels' stamped in orange, Offerte aanvragen.
options.risk: If the label grid is set timidly it reads as paperwork instead of bold.

raised.raise: Every product photo sits at one fixed scale on one shared ground and baseline, so the range reads as a set, not a catalogue dump.
Orange commits as a field that holds a third of the screen where it appears; stock status is a stamped mark, not a coloured badge.
Order codes set at monumental scale (MMC V10, CRIB 5) are the page's main typographic material, not decoration.
Palette law: orange is reserved for stock and action only, never for decoration.

options.label: The Stock Rack
options.lineage: warehouse rack labels and pallet stickers in a Flemish depot
options.thesis: The site as the MMC depot: aisles per use, every product on its shelf with location and code.
options.viewport: Fabric hero, then the range shown as one long rack with shelf labels per use.
options.risk: Familiar logistics look; most runs about stock land here.

options.label: Botanical Folio
options.thesis: Products as plates on one baseline.
options.viewport: Five fixed-scale plates in a row.
options.risk: Cream and italic serif, the softest AI default.
options.case: Fuses poorly: purchasers do not read care products as specimens.
options.kept: One fixed scale and shared ground for every product photo.

options.label: Cutting Bench
options.thesis: Sections strung as frames on a rail.
options.viewport: A perforated rail across an orange field.
options.case: Fuses poorly: no link to mattresses or purchasing.
options.kept: Orange as a committed field, state as a mark.

options.label: Alphabet Storm
options.case: Fuses poorly: purchasers need codes they can read, not weather.
options.kept: Monumental type as the main material.

options.label: Arcade Cabinet
options.risk: Games tone in a care context.
options.kept: A strict palette law for one colour.

canonCard.label: The category standard
canonCard.thesis: A care-supplier site like Duvatex or Sampli, executed at full craft.
canonCard.viewport: Hero photo, category tiles, USP row, contact band.
canonCard.risk: Indistinguishable from the competition by design.
